say:1:1010625001:0.text: We fought our hardest, but it still wasn't enough. We surrender.
say:1:1010625001:0.source_cn: 竭尽全力仍然技不如人，我们输了。

say:2:1010625002:0.text: We have no way of upholding our part of the contract in the face of overwhelming power.
say:2:1010625002:0.source_cn: 无法提供超出能力范围的防护，雇主的契约难以履行，就此失效。

say:3:1010625003:0.text: I will order my men to gradually retreat. Do as you wish here.
say:3:1010625003:0.source_cn: 我会率领部下逐步拔营撤离，诸位请便。

say:7:1010625004:0.text: He's gone... I guess he wasn't such a bad person, after all.
say:7:1010625004:0.source_cn: 他离开了……感觉也不完全是坏人呢?

say:9:1010625005:0.text: General Hogan appreciates honorable fighters like him. Maybe the Heroic Order will have use for their services someday?

say:13:1010625009:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, that must be the place where you hid the seal all those years ago. I can sense its residual magical energy.

say:20:1010625006:0.text: What a shame that their talents and loyalty were wasted on such a terrible person.

say:21:1010625007:0.text: It's a good thing nobody knew you were Merlin all along, or else they would've run off a long time ago.
say:21:1010625007:0.source_cn: 幸好他们不知道你是梅林，否则驻扎在这里的人早就跑光了。
